name: Prison Queendom ~Kyousei M Otoko-ka Choukyou~
source:
Prisoners suffer innumerable indignities at the hands of the guards.
In time, the suffering itself becomes pleasure. They are brought to heel, both physically and in the depths of their souls...

[From [url=http://blog.livedoor.jp/mortalvyses/archives/14939246.html]mortalvysesのblog[/url]]
translation:
囚犯在警卫手中遭受无数屈辱。随着时间流逝，痛苦本身变成快感。他们在身体上与灵魂深处都被驯服……

[来源：[url=http://blog.livedoor.jp/mortalvyses/archives/14939246.html]mortalvyses的博客[/url]]
